opening.argument: The video gives viewers a way to search for Google-product support and advertises a phone number as a support contact. Its title and description call the number Google support, which could blur who provides the service. But the visible note identifies the contact as third party. The distinction matters: the sampled material does not establish that the number belongs to Google, that its operator falsely claimed to be Google, or that any caller was deceived. On this record, the support-search instructions and advertised contact are consistent with an ordinary support service, while the uncertainty about the provider's identity remains a limitation rather than proof of deception.
